crossRefs.note: For you are my hope, Lord Yahweh, my confidence from my youth.
How can a young man keep his way pure? By living according to your word.
I have not turned away from your ordinances, for you have taught me.
Come and hear, all you who fear God. I will declare what he has done for my soul.
Your servant struck both the lion and the bear. This uncircumcised Philistine shall be as one of them, since he has…
David said, “Yahweh who delivered me out of the paw of the lion, and out of the paw of the bear, he will deliver me out…
David answered Rechab and Baanah his brother, the sons of Rimmon the Beerothite, and said to them, “As Yahweh lives…
David spoke to Yahweh the words of this song in the day that Yahweh delivered him out of the hand of all his enemies…
He appointed some of the Levites to minister before Yahweh’s ark, and to commemorate, to thank, and to praise Yahweh…

translations.web: God, you have taught me from my youth. Until now, I have declared your wondrous works.
translations.bsb: O God, You have taught me from my youth, and to this day I proclaim Your marvelous deeds.
translations.kjv: O God, thou hast taught me from my youth: and hitherto have I declared thy wondrous works.
translations.asv: O God, thou hast taught me from my youth; And hitherto have I declared thy wondrous works.
